description: This file defines the FilesystemLoader class in Drupal, which extends Twig's FilesystemLoader to load templates from the filesystem, adding module and theme paths as namespaces, and managing allowed file extensions.

classes.name: FilesystemLoader
classes.description: A class that loads templates from the filesystem, integrating module and theme paths as namespaces, and managing allowed file extensions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with paths, module and theme handlers, and optional Twig configuration, setting up namespace paths and allowed file extensions.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new path for templates under a specified namespace, invalidating the cache.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Finds a template by name, validating file extension, supporting backward compatibility, and throwing errors for invalid extensions.
